text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And then, the day of the Oka Sho arrived.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume can challenge that race only 
once in her life. That is precisely why 
they yearn for it, run for it... and seek 
the one and only tiara of their 
generation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, today will also be Nishino 
Flower's first and last "Oka Sho."
choice_data_list:
(I really want her to run her heart out 
with no regrets...!)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
choice_data_list: Flower, are you okay? Are you hurt?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It's all right! Um, and as for... 
'reviewing the strategy,' that's all set 
too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It seems she kept checking the same 
things with Nishino Flower over and over, 
likely due to nervousness.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um... could it be that you're quite 
nervous?
choice_data_list: Because it's an important race for you.
Because it's an important race for you.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It's all right. After all, haven't we 
worked so hard for this very day?!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...I just feel like today is going to be 
alright."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
True to those words, Nishino Flower was 
remarkably calm.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Since this morning, I've had a feeling. 
That I'll truly run my own race..."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Being welcomed by Trainer's beaming smile. 
That's all I've been imagining this whole 
time.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Because I know you'll understand why it 
had to be "right now"...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A roar of cheers leaking from beyond the 
light. With it at her back, she smiled."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Please keep your eyes on me, 
okay? And then...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Please believe in me and wait!
